meta.title: Fuel Consumption Converter — Convert Liter/100 km and More
meta.description: Free fuel consumption converter for 4+ units including Liter/100 km, Kilometer/Liter, Miles/Gallon (US). Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: L/100km, MPG (US), MPG (UK), km/L. Fast, accurate conversions with engineering-grade precision for everyday and professional use. Convert between 4 fuel consumption units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for fuel consumption in this tool is **lp100km**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most fuel consumption conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:

content.use_cases:
- Cooking and recipe conversions when switching between metric and imperial measurements.
- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this fuel consumption converter?
**A:** It uses 4 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Liter/100 km (L/100km), Kilometer/Liter (km/L), Miles/Gallon (US) (mpg), Miles/Gallon (UK) (mpg (UK)).
